title: Postgres RLS Policy Plan
description: A structured RLS configuration for one table (or a homogeneous table family), so policy-merge semantics, subselect wrapping, index hygiene, and bypass paths can be checked deterministically by scripts/postgres_row_level_security_audit.mjs.

rlsEnabled.description: True if ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is applied (default-deny in effect).

forceRls.description: True if ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is applied so the table owner is also subject to policies.

ownerMayConnect.description: True if the connecting role (e.g. the Postgres user PostgREST connects as) might own tables — the bypass-by-accident condition.

policies.description: One entry per CREATE POLICY statement.

command.description: The FOR clause of the policy.

type.description: AS PERMISSIVE (OR-merged) or AS RESTRICTIVE (AND-merged). Default in Postgres is permissive.

toRoleSpecified.description: True if the policy names TO <role> instead of defaulting to PUBLIC.

usesAuthFunction.description: True if the predicate calls a row-independent auth function (auth.uid(), auth.jwt(), current_setting).

authFnWrappedInSubselect.description: True if every such auth function call is wrapped as (SELECT auth.uid()) for the once-per-statement initPlan.

hasUsing.description: True if the policy has a USING expression (filters visible/affected rows).

hasWithCheck.description: True if the policy has an explicit WITH CHECK expression (validates new row values).

tenantColumnIndexed.description: True if the policy column (user_id / tenant_id) has a btree index — RLS does not create one.

securityDefinerInApiSchema.description: True if any SECURITY DEFINER function is exposed in the API schema (Supabase: public). Must be false.

serviceRoleKeyServerOnly.description: True if the BYPASSRLS service_role credential is strictly server-side and verified absent from client bundles.

viewsUseSecurityInvoker.description: True if data-layer views use WITH (security_invoker = true) (PG15+) or are explicitly designed for RLS bypass.

isolationTested.description: True if an end-to-end test proves one tenant cannot read or write another tenant's rows.
